item.title: Barn Owl 0.9.0
item.description: - **Hide Desktop** now covers the desktop with a picture of your wallpaper instead of restarting Finder, so icons come back exactly where they were and Finder windows stay open. - **Hidden Files** lets Finder quit properly before reopening it, so it keeps its windows and icon positions. - The quick panel no longer closes when Barn Owl moves icons, for example when you start presenting. - When presenting starts, the owl says "Incognito!" instead of "Wide awake!". - **The owl everywhere:** it reacts to the quick toggles, dresses for what's going on (a headset in calls, glasses at your desk, a blanket in closed-lid mode, coffee on long sessions), perks up when you plug in, perches on the Perch, peeks over the Nest's tab and waves files goodbye, follows search results, and covers its eyes when you copy a password. - **Menu bar owl:** its eyes follow your pointer, it winks on Option-click, wears shades while presenting, droops in a session's last minute, glances at icons that pop into view, and blinks awake with your Mac. - **Surprises:** good morning once a day, a livelier night owl, Halloween, New Year and birthday outfits, tonight's real moon in the sky, a throwable owl in About, and `barnowl hoot` in the Terminal. - **Owl personality** in Settings → Appearance: Lively, Calm or Still. - **A collection** in Settings → About: 38 owl moments to meet. - The docs say macOS 26 *and later*: Barn Owl runs on macOS 27 too.

item.title: Barn Owl 0.8.0
item.description: - Barn Owl can update itself. On the second launch it asks whether to check automatically (once a day), and it always asks before installing. Change that or check right away in Settings → General, or use the new button at the bottom of the quick panel. - The Homebrew cask is marked as updating itself, so `brew upgrade` leaves it alone. - Clicking an owl in Settings → Appearance now always switches its colours. Before, a click on the owl itself was sometimes ignored.
